_comment: Tier-2 for skfem poisson#1 (previously 'catalog claim inherited; not separately Tier-2 falsified'). Now measured on skfem 12.0.1: there is no SolverInterface / LinearProblem / KSP name in the skfem namespace (AttributeError: module 'skfem' has no attribute 'LinearProblem'), K is a scipy csr_matrix, and spsolve / factorized / cg on the same condensed system agree, i.e. swapping the solver really is a one-line user-level change.
